title: FullTime/Direct Placement - Security Engineer |  CA, TX, CT, ME (Hybrid)
description:
Software Guidance & Assistance, Inc., (SGA), is searching for an SECURITY ENGINEER for a FULL TIME assignment with one of our premier UTILITY clients.

Locations: San Jose, CA | New Braunfels, TX | Houston, TX | Cromwell, CT | Maine

Position Summary

The Security Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, integrating, and enhancing cybersecurity controls across the organization. This role focuses on security operations, security automation, identity security, cloud security, and the integration of security technologies to improve detection, response, and overall risk reduction. The Security Engineer will work closely with IT infrastructure, cloud, and application teams, as well as support the secure integration of newly acquired companies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with the 24x7 Security Operations Center (SOC) to improve and tune SIEM detections, alerts, and response capabilities.
  • Design, implement, and maintain security integrations across enterprise security platforms and business systems.
  • Support cybersecurity integration activities for mergers and acquisitions, ensuring newly acquired organizations are securely onboarded into enterprise security services.
  • Automate repetitive security and operational tasks through scripting and workflow automation.
  • Strengthen identity and access management controls, including authentication, privileged access, and identity governance processes.
  • Support the secure configuration, monitoring, and continuous improvement of cloud environments.
  • Collaborate with IT and infrastructure teams to review architectures, harden systems, and implement security best practices.
  • Assist in the evaluation, deployment, and ongoing management of security technologies and controls.
  • Participate in incident response activities, investigations, and remediation efforts as needed.
  • Document security processes, standards, and technical procedures.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • Minimum of 3 years of cybersecurity engineering, security operations, or related experience.
  • Hands-on experience with Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) platforms; NetWitness Suite experience preferred.
  • Strong experience with Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) platforms; CrowdStrike experience preferred.
  • Experience developing scripts and automation using PowerShell, Python, or similar languages.
  • Experience implementing security automation and orchestration solutions.
  • Understanding of identity and access management concepts and security best practices.
  • Experience supporting cloud security technologies and configurations in Azure, AWS, or similar environments.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting cybersecurity activities during mergers and acquisitions.
  • Experience with SOAR, API integrations, and workflow automation platforms.
  • Familiarity with Zero Trust security principles.
  • Exposure to vulnerability management, threat detection, and incident response processes.
  • Relevant industry certifications such as CISSP, GIAC, GSEC, Security+, CCSP, or similar.

title: Scientist I
description:
Software Guidance & Assistance, Inc., (SGA), is searching for a Scientist I for a contract assignment with one of our premier Pharmaceutical clients in San Diego, CA.

Responsibilities :
We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Scientist 1 to join our Formulation team. In this hands-on laboratory role, you will work closely with senior scientists to execute and optimize the synthesis of targeted and non-targeted lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) for nucleic acid delivery. The successful candidate will be a collaborative team player with strong technical and data analysis skills who is ready to contribute to our non-viral delivery platform.
  • Execute and optimize the synthesis and characterization of lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) encapsulating nucleic acids for in vitro and in vivo studies under the guidance of senior formulation scientists.
  • Implement Design of Experiment (DoE) based screening campaigns to evaluate and establish optimal LNP compositions and processing parameters.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with internal teams to support and fulfill formulation requests.
  • Support early-stage formulation development and downstream processing activities, including cryoprotection, scale-up, and stability studies.
  • Maintain detailed records documenting formulation activities and results.
  • Analyze, interpret, and present experimental data to the formulation team.
  • Contribute to routine lab management activities, including inventory tracking, supply ordering, buffer preparation, and autoclaving.
Required Skills:
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Chemical Engineering, or a related discipline with 2+ years of biopharma industry experience, OR a Master's degree with 1+ years of industry experience.
  • LNP Expertise: Minimum of 1–2 years of hands-on laboratory experience specializing in LNP formulation and encapsulation of nucleic acids (mRNA, siRNA, or DNA).
  • Analytical Skills: Proficiency with standard LNP characterization methods, including Dynamic Light Scattering (DLS), Zeta potential, and Ribogreen assays.
  • Software & Data: High proficiency in MS Excel is required; hands-on experience with statistical and data analysis software (e.g., JMP, Prism) is preferred.
  • Core Competencies: Strong attention to detail, a track record of producing reproducible data, excellent organizational skills, and the ability to communicate effectively within a fast-paced team environment.
Preferred Skills:
  • Prior experience with Tangential Flow Filtration (TFF), dialysis, and bioconjugation chemistry is highly desirable.

title: Full Stack Engineer (Java, Spring Boot, Angular & AI)
description:
Software Guidance & Assistance, Inc. (SGA) is searching for a Full Stack Engineer for a contract assignment with one of our premier financial services clients in New York, NY.

We are seeking a hands-on, Full Stack Engineer to join the New York–based ESPT Technology team, building and modernizing mission-critical platforms for Equity Derivatives and Structured Products businesses. You will design and deliver scalable systems across front-office trading, trade capture, post-trade processing, and lifecycle management workflows, partnering directly with Trading, Sales, Operations, Risk, Strats, and Technology partners.
The ideal candidate pairs deep Java and Angular engineering with strong distributed-systems design and a proven ability to leverage AI-assisted development to accelerate delivery. This is a senior individual-contributor role for an engineer who enjoys solving complex business and technical problems while shaping architecture, engineering standards, and platform strategy.

Responsibilities:
  • Own end-to-end technical delivery for complex initiatives, from requirements analysis and architecture through implementation, testing, production rollout, and ongoing support.
  • Design, build, and maintain scalable enterprise applications, APIs, and user interfaces using Java, Spring Boot, and Angular across front-office and post-trade workflows.
  • Develop high-performance distributed systems that process large volumes of business-critical transactions, and lead architecture and design reviews across strategic platforms.
  • Drive modernization of legacy applications toward microservices, event-driven, and modern platform architectures, improving resiliency, scalability, and observability.
  • Apply AI-assisted development tools responsibly across the SDLC, including coding, testing, documentation, code review, troubleshooting, and workflow automation.
  • Translate business needs from Trading, Sales, Operations, Risk, and Compliance into robust technical solutions and deliver strategic and regulatory commitments.
  • Provide technical leadership during production incidents, troubleshoot complex distributed-systems issues, and drive continuous improvement in monitoring and stability.
Required Skills:
  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related discipline.
  • 5–8 years of professional software development experience.
  • Extensive hands-on Java development and strong experience building modern web applications with Angular and TypeScript.
    • Backend: Java 11+, Spring / Spring Boot, REST APIs, microservices, messaging / event-driven architectures, distributed systems
    • Frontend: Angular, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS, modern UI frameworks
    • Engineering Excellence: Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing & test automation, code review, performance optimization
  • Proven experience designing and supporting large-scale distributed systems, RESTful services, and microservice architectures.
  • Commitment to engineering excellence, including clean design, high-quality code, automated testing, code reviews, documentation, and continuous improvement of development practices.
  • Solid grounding in data structures, algorithms, software design, relational databases, and SQL.
  • Track record of delivery in Agile environments, with strong analytical skills, clear communication across technical and business audiences, and a strong ownership mindset.
  • Ability to operate independently in a fast-paced front-office environment, balancing delivery speed, system resiliency, production stability, and risk/control awareness.
  • AI-Assisted Engineering
  • Our team is investing heavily in AI-assisted engineering, and we place particular value on engineers who bring:
  • Applied use of generative AI tools to improve software engineering productivity, quality, and delivery outcomes.
  • Practical experience with prompt engineering and workflow automation that improves engineering effectiveness.
  • Curiosity and a strong willingness to adopt emerging technologies that enhance software engineering.
Preferred Skills:

Experience in one or more of the following is highly desirable:
  • Domain: Structured Products, Equity Derivatives, Front-Office Trading Systems, Lifecycle Management, Trade Processing, Risk Management, Investment Banking Technology
  • Platform: Kafka or similar messaging, containerization & orchestration, cloud platforms, observability & monitoring

title: Sr Program Manager
description:
Software Guidance & Assistance, Inc., (SGA), is searching for a Sr Program Manager for a contract assignment with one of our premier Human Resources clients in Dunwoody, GA.

Responsibilities :
The Staff Program Manager is focused on driving the execution of cross-functional programs in alignment with strategic business priorities and goals. This role enables execution and implementation across multiple teams, facilitating decision-making, stakeholder engagement, change management, and risk management.

This role is responsible for leading large programs that span multiple business units, with multiple workstreams and/or projects. They will handle resourcing, milestone plans, complex interdependencies, communication across a broad audience with varying needs, and enable organizational/business readiness, all in conjunction with an agile development construct.

Program Managers are focused on the delivery of projects and achieving intended business outcomes through the use of product and technology, business processes, and change management. Leadership skills and the ability to apply critical understanding of the problem and solution at hand, rather than technical skills, are key.

In addition, this role will support strategic planning, portfolio management, prioritization, executive reporting, dependency management, and cross-functional alignment activities to enable successful execution of business objectives and transformation initiatives.
  • Leadership
    • Executive communications and delivering messaging with the right level of detail and context to drive productive dialogues
    • Manage multiple competing priorities and drive toward a path forward in collaboration with key stakeholders
    • Ability to synthesize information
    • Leadership through relationship building and influence
    • Operates as a trusted adviser to project and program partners, sponsors, and stakeholders
    • Defines success criteria in partnership with stakeholders and directs the team in alignment with those goals
  • Critical Thinking
    • Applies critical thinking to understand interdependencies between technology, operations, and business needs
    • Demonstrates a functional acuity to support how solutions will address intended outcomes while anticipating risks and issues with mitigation strategies and effective roadblock removal
    • Evaluates business tradeoffs and facilitates informed decision-making across stakeholder groups
  • Stakeholder Management
    • Develops governance structure to keep key stakeholders aware and involved in key projects
    • Ensures that key business stakeholders are involved and their requirements accounted for in the solution and delivery timeline
    • Communicates with stakeholders about progress and issues that are relevant to them
    • Facilitates executive and leadership-level discussions to support alignment, prioritization, and decision-making
  • General Program Management
    • Independently handles a variety of portfolio projects ranging in complexity that span one or multiple lines of business
    • Manages the day-to-day program activities and resources; chairs the program management team meetings
    • Willing to jump in and support the team on deliverables when needed
  • Scope / Schedule
    • Handles scope and changes
    • Prepares and maintains a detailed plan for all phases that is shared and visible to relevant partners
    • Monitors, tracks, and controls outcomes to resolve issues, conflicts, dependencies, and critical path deliverables
    • Manages cross-program dependencies and proactively identifies execution risks and resource constraints
  • Resources
    • Prepares detailed resource estimates aligning with the planned activities
    • Negotiates with resource managers to procure adequate resources to achieve objectives in planned timeframes
    • Delegates tasks and responsibilities to appropriate resources
  • Reporting and Communication
    • Reports on success criteria results, metrics, test, and deployment management activities
    • Provides status on milestones, deliverables, dependencies, risks, and issues
    • Effective communication both written and verbal to summarize the situation and provide relevant information for progress, blockers, and key decisions required
    • Creates executive-level presentations, status reporting, dashboards, and strategic recommendations for leadership audiences
    • Other projects and responsibilities may be added at the manager's discretion.
Required Skills:
  • Bachelor's Degree desired; or demonstrated relevant experience.
  • With a Bachelor's degree, 8+ years of experience in Program Management
  • Managing teams directly or through projects
  • Experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives involving multiple stakeholders and workstreams
  • Ability to complete routine work with little to no supervision and instruction, and general instruction over new projects or assignments
  • Demonstrates ability to work on problems of diverse scope where analysis of data requires evaluation of identifiable factors
  • Demonstrates good judgment in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions
  • Ability to communicate with employees at all levels of the organization, especially with senior internal and external personnel in own area of expertise
  • Work typically impacts direct peers, supervisors, executives, and cross-functional partners
  • Capable of applying a full understanding of program management to resolve a wide range of issues in creative ways
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Excellent interpersonal skills
  • Excellent presentation and facilitation skills
  • Demonstrated ability to influence outcomes across a matrixed organization without direct authority
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex dependencies, competing priorities, and stakeholder expectations
  • A demonstrated commitment to high professional ethical standards and a diverse workplace
  • Ability to adapt to a fast-paced continually changing business and work environment while managing multiple priorities
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite
Preferred Skills:
  • PMP desired
  • Experience supporting strategic planning, portfolio management, enterprise transformation, or organizational change initiatives preferred

title: Risk Consultant
description:
Software Guidance & Assistance, Inc., (SGA), is searching for an Risk Consultant for a CONTRACT assignment with one of our premier Financial Services clients in Morristown, NJ.

100% Remote

Job Details:

  • Multi-state workers comp state reporting experience

title: Scientist I
description:
Software Guidance & Assistance, Inc., (SGA), is searching for a Scientist I for a contract assignment with one of our premier Pharmaceutical clients in San Diego, CA.

Responsibilities :
The Scientist I will be a vital contributor to our non-viral cell and gene therapy delivery platform, primarily focused on R&D for innovative nucleic acid payload technologies. This role involves evaluating novel mRNA and DNA designs using a range of molecular biology techniques, including plasmid cloning, in vitro validation, and the production of in vitro-transcribed mRNA. To verify successful expression, the scientist will utilize assays such as Western blot, qRT-PCR, and luciferase reporter assays.
  • Design and clone expression vectors and IVT donor plasmids to support research initiatives.
  • Execute DNA and mRNA transfections in mouse and human cell lines.
  • Assess nucleic acid expression through molecular methods like qPCR, reporter assays and Western blotting.
  • Maintenance of detailed electronic laboratory notebooks (ELN) and preparation of summary slides
Required Skills:
  • Education/Experience: Bachelor's degree with 2+ years or a Master's degree with 1+ years of experience in molecular biology, pharmaceutical sciences, or a related field.
  • Molecular Biology: Required proficiency in advanced cloning (Gibson assembly, Golden Gate, site-directed mutagenesis) and IVT.
  • Functional Assays: Hands-on expertise in measuring transgene delivery success via reporter assays and qRT-PCR.
  • Communication: Exceptional oral and written skills with a meticulous attention to detail.
  • Must haves for this position are:
  • Molecular cloning and DNA manipulation techniques (e.g. Gibson assembly, GoldenGate cloning, site-directed mutagenesis)
  • Work with RNA, especially preparing in vitro-transcribed mRNA
  • Experience with molecular assays to assess gene - e.g. Western blot, luciferase reporter assays, qRT-PCR)
Preferred Skills:
  • Cell Culture: Preferred experience in genetic manipulation of cell lines and primary cells (e.g., T cells, monocytes, hepatocytes).
  • Software/Tools: Desired proficiency in Snapgene, Prism, and MS Office.
